title: ISW Cross-Correlation Predictions for Energy-Flow Cosmology with DESI DR1 Tracers
abstract: This paper computes the CMB–galaxy ISW cross-correlation C_ell^{Tg} for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) using linear perturbation theory and DESI DR1–motivated tracer windows over multipoles ell=2–60. It introduces a bounded cancellation index C that isolates opposite-sign contributions from the standard ISW kernel and an EFC transition kernel driven by a time-varying gravitational coupling mu(a). The key prediction is a strong, redshift-dependent suppression of the ISW amplitude near the EFC transition epoch (z_t ≈ 0.82), providing clear falsifiable tests against ΛCDM.
